an5.166:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
an5.166:1.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:1.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an5.166:2.2: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso sāriputta anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi

an5.166:4.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an5.166:4.2: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso sāriputta anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:5.2: yāvatatiyampi kho me āyasmā udāyi paṭikkosati na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati
an5.166:5.4: athakho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
an5.166:5.5: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.166:5.6: idhāvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:5.8: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi

an5.166:8.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an5.166:8.2: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso sāriputta anavakāso yaṃ so bhikkhu atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:9.2: bhagavatopi kho me sammukhā āyasmā udāyi yāvatiyakaṃ paṭikkosati na ca me koci bhikkhu anumodati
an5.166:10.2: kaṃ pana tvaṃ udāyi manomayaṃ kāyaṃ paccesīti
an5.166:10.3: ye te bhante devā arūpino saññāmayāti
an5.166:10.4: kiṃ nu kho tuyhaṃ udāyi bālassa abyattassa bhaṇitena
an5.166:11.2: atthi nāma ānanda theraṃ bhikkhuṃ vihesiyamānaṃ ajjhupekkhissatha
an5.166:11.3: na hi nāma ānanda kāruññaṃpi bhavissati byattamhi bhikkhumhi vihesiyamānamhīti.
an5.166:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:12.4: no ce diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya atikkammeva kabaḷiṃ kārāhārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjeyyapi vuṭṭhaheyyapi
an5.166:12.7: idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an5.166:13.1: athakho āyasmā ānando acirapakkantassa bhagavato yenāyasmā upavāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upavānaṃ etadavoca
an5.166:13.2: idhāvuso upavāna aññe there bhikkhū vihesenti
an5.166:13.4: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso upavāna yaṃ bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito etadeva ārabbha udāhareyya yathā āyasmantaññevettha upavānaṃ paṭibhāseyya
an5.166:13.6: athakho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavānaṃ etadavoca
an5.166:14.1: katihi nu kho upavāna dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
an5.166:14.2: pañcahi bhante dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca
an5.166:14.4: idha bhante thero bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an5.166:14.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
an5.166:14.7: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an5.166:14.8: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an5.166:14.9: imehi kho bhante pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
an5.166:15.2: imehi kho upavāna pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca
an5.166:15.3: ime ce upavāna pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno na saṃvijjeyyuṃ kena naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkareyyuṃ garukareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ khaṇḍiccena pāliccena vallittacatāya
an5.166:15.4: yasmā ca kho upavāna ime pañca dhammā therassa bhikkhuno saṃvijjanti tasmā taṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti garukaronti mānenti pūjentīti.
